mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate over the prior three months indicates a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE declines by at least 0.2 percentage points over the prior three months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is at or below 0.25% for three consecutive months, it signals an extreme monetary easing policy that lowers discount rates and supports equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next five trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS <= 0.25% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (indicating a supply shock) and an increase in retail sales (indicating demand recovery) signals a business cycle turning point, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO falls by more than 2% and RSAFS rises by more than 0.5% in the same month.

mechanism_narrative: During high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 9.0%), a decline in the unemployment rate by more than 0.3 percentage points over three months signals labor market improvement, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 9.0%), SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE declines by more than 0.3pp over three months.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production (INDPRO) over the prior month indicates improving supply conditions, which supports corporate output and profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO rises by at least 0.5% over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 1.0% signals weak consumer demand, which leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next five trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS declines by more than 1.0% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and an increase in employment signals coordinated monetary and labor market stimulus, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines by more than 0.1pp and PAYEMS increases by more than 0.2% in the same month.

mechanism_narrative: During low inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL < 1.5% annualized), a decline in the federal funds rate signals an attempt to combat deflation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In low inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL < 1.5%), SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines by more than 0.1pp.
